mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it brought the two defenses together and showed how bleeding stops.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was a straightforward setup step; it was less informative than seeing how the plug and threads worked.

surprise.text: The sealed vessel did not mean the skin had healed too. Those are separate parts of the repair.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the introduction and picture labels explained why the pieces belonged together.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the still-open skin heals, since stopping the bleeding was only the first repair.
